The '''fighting on Immalia''' referred to a [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] engagement between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Immalia]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Rebel forces retreated upon sighting approaching Imperial [[radiation zone assault trooper]]s, believing they were fighting in an area exposed to [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. Only later did the Rebels learn that the Imperials merely had access to radtrooper [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that [[Standard day/Legends|day]] and that they retreated for nothing.<ref name="IH:ACG" />
